name: Death Assistant
source:
A college girl named Charlie is a struggling student who dies of a heart attack. However, Death is on vacation, so it hires Charlie to take over its work. If Charlie messes up, she will be trapped in purgatory forever; if she succeeds, she will get her life back – and a little extra cash.

[From [url=https://jurou-kohishiro.itch.io/death-assistant]Itch.io[/url]]
